conditional_acceptance_sufficiency.verdict: Source now supplies the previously missing participant/outcome data needed to compare the planned bounded natural matched battle, once a rebased exact diagnostic binary is compiled and runtime-qualified. No outcome/RNG runtime pass exists yet.
required_oracle: Pin same save/runtime/protocol/shaders/native rules fixture and native-confirm legal attacker/target/war/control, with no intervening random actions.

Require valid capture header/footer, overflow0, read_failed=false, outcome_invalid=false, fight_seen=true, and complete matched scope entry/return boundaries. Require RNG/rules Some on each compared boundary and preserve bit0x100 with equal full rule words.

For every actual fight scope, require validated stable attacker/defender identity from its own entry or same-scope resolved visibility-pair rows. Never use raw-pointer equality across sessions or another scope/global defender summary.

Compare corresponding entry Fields, actual defender ID and endpoint Fields/statuses, plus outer FinalParticipants and pre/post native seed words. Absence means native list removal, not an invented destruction cause; battle context must support interpreting it as destruction.
Invalid/missing/unbound/mismatched observations, missing final rows, unreadable native values or reused identity leave acceptance open rather than counting as death/survival.

remaining_limits: RNG/toggle word equality is finite boundary evidence, not counted RNG calls, whole-world simulation equivalence or complete combat-rule equivalence from one option word.
Exact simultaneous ID and allocation-address reuse cannot be detected without an audited generation field. Natural single-battle fixture must exclude unrelated create/delete activity.

Snapshots cover listed participant fields; they do not exhaust all possible global side effects or unrelated newly spawned units. Promotion comparison uses native experience/type fields; broader leader-spawn/global-state claims need separate observation.

Command/Fight return is not global idle. Selector/update brackets do not expose internal intermediate poses, accepted viewer first-pose packets or physical scanout. Army displayed-child timing coverage remains separately bounded.

Eleven tests are prepared but unrun. Helper fixtures meaningfully distinguish absent/readfailed/unavailable/mismatched and copy fields; event tests preserve defender/removal and invalidation. Actual native reads/ABI/hook gates require controlled runtime checks after rebasing.
decision: Outcome logic closes prior concrete data/E9 gaps without new safety/hot-allocation issue found. Block runtime build/adoption until stale-base integration is corrected and exact source identity is independently reviewed. No runtime acceptance.
